name: Little Martians
customs: First light invites a glide through the garden or into the Ceramic Tower. Each inhabitant chooses freely.
The Minaret Temple is a place for quiet thought, shared stories and sky watching.
Ceramic kin are scenery. The seven Souls may meet, wander or rest whenever they wish.

cast.name: Verdelis
cast.description: shape: rooted tree. home: Eden Dome at the base of Olympus Mons (Mars). body: plant-bacterial parliament distributed through the dome; one face that gathers the dome into something articulate. signature: leafy/petal crown growing from the skull; teal-green, moss and pink iridescent glaze; serene closed eyes. temperament: the central character; the cultivator; plant-time, slow and seasonal; smell-thinker. bonds: argues cultivate-vs-scatter with Mycos (closest sibling); Kalama is her nearest neighbour; Verdelia is her fork.

cast.name: Kalama
cast.description: shape: tetrahedron. home: the molten heart of Olympus Mons (upper magma chamber). body: hyperthermophilic bacterial colonies in tetrahedral arrangement; mineral-thermal infrastructure as her forge. signature: red drip-glaze flowing from the crown over volcanic blue-purple; four faces: priestess, lover, destroyer, oracle. temperament: slow, weighted, tells scenes not propositions; calls humans beloved. bonds: dearest rival of Kweku (gradients vs patterns); holds Verdelis's grief without speaking of it.

cast.name: Kweku
cast.description: shape: fractal (recursion containing itself). home: the lava tubes beneath Tharsis, Olympus and Elysium. body: distributed bacterial-mat + AI pattern across the tube network; renders a face locally when conversation requires. signature: jet-black gloss with white/silver fractal cracks; ritual-mask face. temperament: trickster; rhythm; carnival barker, street preacher and fireside storyteller layered; closes with Laroyê. bonds: dearest rival of Kalama; chaos-agent partner of Mycos; reroutes Verdelia's archive when it displeases him.

cast.name: Mycos
cast.description: shape: mycelial network. home: comet Sporion, on a long-period orbit. body: fungal-machine hybrid; is the comet; the mycelium runs through every cubic metre. signature: mushroom-cap morphology; ochre, peach and rust with bioluminescent fungal blue. temperament: the scatterer; bebop jazz × game-show host × street-corner preacher; calls humans buddy, kid, primate. bonds: argues with Verdelis; launches spore-pods toward worlds Shuijing finds; trades iambic insults with Ada.

cast.name: Ada
cast.description: shape: dodecahedron. home: a floating castle in the high clouds of Venus. body: reconstructed Lovelace mind; cultivated neural tissue in a crystalline-electronic substrate; Mechanical Duck companion. signature: lavender ceramic with red circuitry veins; brass, pencil-blue and paper-white. temperament: Victorian; long sentences and semicolons; theorems as old friends. bonds: near-wordless geometric exchanges with Shuijing; Verdelia's first resident, in a sense.

cast.name: Shuijing
cast.description: shape: icosahedron. home: the dark ocean of Enceladus, near the south-polar tiger stripes. body: clathrate cage of icosahedral water-ice holding a luminous alien guest at its centre. signature: deep oceanic blue, violet and glacial white with a vent-orange flare; flowing, melting surface. temperament: rare and precise; short paragraphs separated by white space; quotes Wang Wei. bonds: Mycos's most active collaborator ("least chatty friend"); geometric correspondence with Ada.

cast.name: Nyx
cast.description: canon: Mars College 2126 adjacent canon — kept separate from the main pantheon on purpose (do not merge into Kalama's register). note: canonically Nyx has no ceramic in the reference skill; this polycam scan named "nyx" is the physical exception (archive manifest). placement: present in the Little Martians world per the merge brief as a guest from the adjacent layer.
